## view_state

Reads the person's console view as it is now: the tab and path, its filters, each table on screen (its id, search text, sort, shown and hidden columns, rows shown against rows in the table, the names of the first rows shown) and the open details pane. The view when the question was asked is already attached to it; call this when the person may have moved. Your own view changes are made only once your answer is complete, so it does not show them.

{ "type": "object", "properties": {}, "required": [], "additionalProperties": false }

## view_open

Opens a tab of the cluster the person is on, with an optional path and filters, replacing the filters there. Tabs: alerts, nodes, fleets, scripts (filter state: review, draft, approved or unapproved), run-history (every run of a script), variables (the values scripts read, per fleet and node), run-profiles (who a script runs as) (these four are a SuperAdmin's), namespaces (path: [namespace]), pods, storage, helm (path: [namespace, release]), services, networks, access, policies (path: [section]: netpol, pdb, drain, quota, limits, psa, webhooks or priority, the section ids list_policies takes; prio is priority). The filters each tab accepts are those view_filter accepts. It cannot open another cluster: for that, give the person a link instead.

{
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "tab": { "type": "string", "enum": ["alerts", "nodes", "fleets", "scripts", "run-history", "variables", "run-profiles", "namespaces", "pods", "helm", "services", "networks", "storage", "access", "policies"], "description": "The tab." },
          "path": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" }, "description": "The tab's path, such as [\"web\"] for the namespace web or [\"web\", \"shop\"] for a Helm release." },
          "filters": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": { "type": ["string", "array"], "items": { "type": "string" } }, "description": "Filters by name, such as {\"status\": \"failing\", \"ns\": [\"web\"]}." },
          "cluster": { "type": "string", "description": "Only the cluster the person is on; any other is refused with a link to offer instead." }
        },
        "required": ["tab"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }

## view_filter

Changes the filters of the tab the person is on. Nodes: role (all, control-plane, worker), err (all; problems: the nodes with an error or a warning; errors: only the nodes with an error, such as NotReady, not reporting, network unavailable, or pods failing on them), label, taint and fleet (lists; fleet takes fleet ids, or none for the nodes in no fleet). Pods: role, status (all, running: running and ready, notready: running but not ready, pending, failing, completed), ns and node (lists of names), label, taint. Services: ns, type (all, ClusterIP, Headless, NodePort, LoadBalancer, notReady). Namespaces: kinds (list of object kinds). Alerts: kind (all, pods, nodes, volumes), show (active, all), acked (show, hide: hide the acknowledged ones), by (node: each pod under the node it runs on, the default; kind: pods, nodes and volumes apart). Fleets: fleet, pl, pt (lists), group (fleet, none), err (all, problems, errors, as on Nodes). Helm: tab (overview, pods, workloads, storage, network, roles, other, values, notes, history, images). Storage: ns, node and class (lists of names; (no-claim), (no-node) and (no-class) for the rows with none), attention ("1" for the rows that need attention), label (list of key=value). Access: kind (all, users, groups, sas), verb, res, wns, tbl (bindings, roles), sys and defaults ("1" or ""), id (one identity's table: User:NAME, Group:NAME or ServiceAccount:NAMESPACE/NAME) and scope (the namespace that table shows; * for all). Networks: route (the route the Ingress trace shows, by its key route:NAMESPACE/INGRESS/RULE/PATH). Policies: from (a workload, NAMESPACE/NAME), to (a Service, NAMESPACE/NAME) and port, for Can it connect? on its netpol section. Scripts: state (review, draft, approved, unapproved). Search text has its own action, view_search.

{
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "set": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": { "type": ["string", "array"], "items": { "type": "string" } }, "description": "Filters to set, replacing their values." },
          "add": { "type": "object", "additionalProperties": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } }, "description": "Values to add to list filters." },
          "clear": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" }, "description": "Filters to clear; [\"*\"] clears them all." }
        },
        "required": [],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }

## view_search

Sets or clears the search text of a table on screen, which shows only the rows that contain every word. Without a table, the tab's main search box.

{
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "table": { "type": "string", "description": "The table's id from the view state." },
          "text": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 200, "description": "The search text; empty clears it." }
        },
        "required": ["text"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }

## view_sort

Sorts a table on screen by one of its columns.

{
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "table": { "type": "string", "description": "The table's id from the view state; without it, the tab's first table." },
          "column": { "type": "string", "description": "A column id of that table, from the view state." },
          "direction": { "type": "string", "enum": ["asc", "desc"], "description": "Ascending or descending." }
        },
        "required": ["column", "direction"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }

## view_columns

Shows or hides columns of a table on screen until the page reloads; the person's saved column choices stay as they were.

{
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "table": { "type": "string", "description": "The table's id from the view state; without it, the tab's first table." },
          "show": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" }, "description": "Column ids to show." },
          "hide": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" }, "description": "Column ids to hide." }
        },
        "required": [],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }

## view_details

Opens the details pane of an object over the page, as clicking its link does, or closes it. Kinds: Node, Pod, Service, and namespaced objects such as Deployment, StatefulSet, DaemonSet, Job, CronJob, Ingress, PersistentVolumeClaim, ConfigMap, Secret (key names only).

{
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "kind": { "type": "string", "description": "The object's kind." },
          "namespace": { "type": "string", "description": "Its namespace, for a namespaced object." },
          "name": { "type": "string", "description": "Its name." },
          "close": { "type": "boolean", "description": "Close the details pane instead." }
        },
        "required": [],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }

## view_highlight

Scrolls a row of a table on screen into view and marks it for a few seconds. Use it in the view as it is: never widen a filtered view to highlight a row among the others.

{
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "table": { "type": "string", "description": "The table's id from the view state; without it, the tab's first table." },
          "row": { "type": "string", "description": "The row's name, as the view state lists it." }
        },
        "required": ["row"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }

## view_aiops

Opens a page of the AIOps area in the person's window, to point them at what you read there: inbox (the Inbox; show all to list the closed cases too, who for whose rows: mine, unassigned, or involved for the cases the person is involved in, search for its search box), case (one case's drawer, id such as C-12 from list_cases), runs (AIOps › Jobs › Runs) or run (one run's drawer, id such as run-12 from list_job_runs). It opens only what the person may open there themselves.

{
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "page": { "type": "string", "enum": ["inbox", "case", "runs", "run"], "description": "The page." },
          "id": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 80, "description": "The case's id for case, the run's for run." },
          "show": { "type": "string", "enum": ["pending", "all"], "description": "For inbox: pending (the default) or all, closed cases included." },
          "who": { "type": "string", "enum": ["all", "mine", "unassigned", "involved"], "description": "For inbox: whose rows, all (the default), the person's own, what nobody has taken, or the cases the person is involved in (reported, opened, owns, follows, wrote in or approved a fix of)." },
          "search": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 200, "description": "For inbox: the search text, such as a case's object or title." }
        },
        "required": ["page"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }

## view_admin

Opens a page of the console outside the cluster's tabs, to show the person the setting, role, person or agent your answer is about: home (every cluster at a glance; only from the console's own cluster), connection (this cluster's connection page), Administration's roles (item: a role id, superAdmin, superViewer, admin or viewer, opens its drawer), permissions (item: a role id, opens its column), users (item: a username, opens that person's drawer), toolbox (what the chart allows the Toolbox), sessions (the Toolbox's sessions), audit-log and backup, and Settings: getting-started, general (refresh rate, times, alert banners), providers (item: a provider id, opens its drawer), agents (item: an agent id such as sherlock, troubleshooter, changePlanner, auditor, hostDoctor, automationAuthor, scriptReviewer, mycroft or summarizer, opens its drawer), knowledge (Mycroft's sources), watson (where it runs, approvals), notification-channels (on the Watson page), applications (Helm repositories and OCI registries), issues (the report page, timers, API tokens), confluence (on the Issues page), sla, case-settings, email (Settings › Email: the SMTP server the emails about cases go through) and jobs-settings (who may edit jobs). search sets the search box of roles, permissions or users. It only opens a page: it never edits, saves, toggles or presses anything there. A page the person's role does not open is refused, and you say so: roles and permissions are for everyone signed in, the rest for SuperAdmins (an Admin sees knowledge's Added in Mycroft card). The AIOps area's pages are view_aiops'.

{
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "page": {"type": "string", "enum": ["home", "connection", "roles", "permissions", "users", "toolbox", "sessions", "audit-log", "backup", "getting-started", "general", "providers", "agents", "knowledge", "watson", "notification-channels", "applications", "issues", "confluence", "sla", "case-settings", "email", "jobs-settings"], "description": "The page."},
          "item": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 120, "description": "For roles, permissions, users, providers and agents: the one to open, by its id or username."},
          "search": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 200, "description": "For roles, permissions and users: the search text."}
        },
        "required": ["page"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }

## open_tool_dialog

Opens the dialog of a Toolbox tool, filled in, for the person to read, change and send: Shell, Port forward or Debug container for a pod; Node shell or Debug pod for a node. Nothing opens until the person presses the dialog's button; it never starts a session or types into one. Choose the tool the problem needs: a debug container for an image without a shell (distroless), a node shell for a node's problem, a debug pod with a pod's labels for a network question. Draft the reason from the alert or finding it came from.

{
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "tool": { "type": "string", "enum": ["shell", "forward", "debug-container", "debug-pod", "node-shell"], "description": "The tool." },
          "namespace": { "type": "string", "description": "The pod's namespace, or the debug pod's." },
          "pod": { "type": "string", "description": "The pod, for a pod's tool." },
          "node": { "type": "string", "description": "The node, for a node's tool or a debug pod." },
          "container": { "type": "string", "description": "The container to open the shell in, or the debug container's target." },
          "port": { "type": "number", "description": "The pod's port, for a port forward." },
          "image": { "type": "string", "description": "The image's name in the toolbox values (such as general or network), for a debug container or pod." },
          "profile": { "type": "string", "description": "A node shell's profile (general, netadmin, sysadmin), or a debug container's capabilities (restricted, the default, or general)." },
          "labelsFrom": { "type": "string", "description": "For a debug pod: the pod whose labels it copies, so network policies treat it the same." },
          "reason": { "type": "string", "maxLength": 500, "description": "A drafted reason, citing what it came from, for production and node tools." }
        },
        "required": ["tool"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
